siderealRotationHours.note: Adopted period at 16° latitude; the Sun's rotation rate varies with latitude.

obliquityDeg.note: Tilt of the Sun's equator relative to the ecliptic.

orbit.note: The Sun is the origin of the heliocentric frame used for all positions.

description.text: The Sun is the star at the heart of our solar system. Its gravity holds the solar system together, keeping everything – from the biggest planets to the smallest bits of debris – in its orbit.
